run_flowmatching_text_training: run the flow matching text model training script with Hydra config and multi-GPU support
run_training_single_gpu: run the training loop on a single GPU by setting compute.ngpus to 1 in the config
run_training_multi_gpu: run the training loop across multiple GPUs using torch multiprocessing spawn with forkserver
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume a previous training run by passing load_dir to load the saved Hydra config
configure_training_with_hydra: configure the training run using Hydra with config files in the configs directory
